text:
Priya: FYI Greenline sent their infosec questionnaire. Main asks are RBAC change justification/audit trails, audit log retention/export, KMS integration (BYOK/HSM/envelope), vuln triage SLA, and incident response timeline. Can someone take point?

Ethan: I can take RBAC + KMS clarifications. Do they want answers for Hosted only or Private as well?

Priya: Both. They specifically want details for Private/on‑prem (how keys are stored, rotation proof, and key provenance). Also a question about tamper‑proof audit logs and export proofs.

Mira: For audit exports we support S3 export, syslog (TLS) to customer SIEM, and signed bundles. Default retention is 13 months for hosted; private deployments can be configured per contract. See docs: https://redwood.example.com/docs/audit-exports

Sam (oncall): Incident notifications: we notify customer within 1 hour for Sev1, preliminary timeline within 4 hours, full incident report within 72 hours, and a postmortem for major incidents within 7 days. For Private we can enable customer-run oncall + webhook delivery to their pager. :white_check_mark:

Ethan: KMS notes: Private supports customer HSM or cloud KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS). We use envelope encryption; runtime uses DEKs and never stores the customer's KEK in plaintext. For hosted customers we can enable EKM integration on request. Example rotation command (private admin):

```bash
# rotate KEK binding
redwood-admin kms rotate --tenant=greenline --key-id=key-1234 --verify
```

Priya: For vuln triage they asked about timelines. Our standard: initial triage within 72 hours, remediation plan for Critical within 14 days, High within 30 days. We notify affected tenants for any tenant-impacting CVEs and provide tracking.

Mira: On tamper-evidence: we can produce SHA256-signed log bundles and optionally write snapshots to a WORM S3 bucket. We also support syslog over mTLS to customer infrastructure so logs never transit third-party.

Ethan: Action items: I will draft RBAC + KMS text and include the envelope diagram + rotation proof. Mira add the audit export examples and signed-bundle process. Sam confirm exact SLA wording and attach the incident runbook links. Priya will collate into the response doc.

Priya: ETA end of day tomorrow? I'll open a GH draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/security-answers/greenline-qn and add the questionnaire PDF. @security-bot please ping us in 24h for a status check.
